payload.detail: CURVE RECORDED 2026-10-21 (docs/audit/2026-10-21-database-performance-evidence.md), local PostgreSQL 16, per canonicalisation pass: 843 records 1.3 s, 1,686 5.2 s, 3,372 8.2 s, 6,744 14.7 s; live is roughly 1.5 times slower and activation runs at least two passes. service_role statement timeout is 15 min, so the caller's request timeout is the ceiling (about 20 to 25 s at 3,000 records). Re-measure before a release passes about 2,000 records. Still do not rewrite the function.
